Aurel — Personal Finance Tracker
=================================

How to use:
1. Unzip this folder.
2. Double-click index.html to open it in your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari).
   No installation, server, or internet account needed.

What it does:
- Dashboard: monthly balance, income, expenses, subscription cost, category donut chart, recent transactions, upcoming renewals
- Transactions: add / edit / delete income and expenses, filter by type, category, and month
- Subscriptions: track recurring charges (weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly), see next renewal date and combined monthly/annual cost
- Analytics: 6-month income vs. expense trend chart, all-time category breakdown
- Settings: change the currency symbol, set an optional monthly budget, export your data as JSON, load demo data, or clear everything

Data & privacy:
- Everything is saved in your browser's local storage on your own device only.
- Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Clearing your browser data will erase it, so use
  Settings → Export as JSON to keep a backup.
- The app ships with a little demo data pre-loaded so it isn't empty on first open;
  clear it any time from Settings.

Notes:
- Works fully offline after the first load, except for the two Google Fonts /
  Chart.js CDN requests used for styling and charts — if you're offline these
  will just fall back to system fonts / no charts, the rest of the app still works.
